name: Motion Graphics
summary: Create concise, design-led motion graphics where movement carries the message.
problem: Short kinetic pieces lose impact when animation, typography and information hierarchy are designed as separate concerns.
coreOutcomes: Translate one visual idea into a compact motion concept
Compose kinetic typography, data or brand elements
Build and validate a short HyperFrames composition
requirements: A concise motion-first brief, such as a headline, statistic, chart, logo or callout
boundaries: Intended for short unnarrated motion-first pieces, not long narrated videos or live-action edits
Use a specialized workflow for product launches, explainers, PR videos or captioned footage
